content: Dɑrusi Pɛɛsibɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yirusen suru nɔɔbɑ tiɑsen tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru sɔɔrɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u kɑ Sorobɑbɛli Seɑlitiɛlin bii, Yudɑbɑn kpɑro kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero Yosue, Yosɑdɑkin bii ɡɑri kuɑ sɑɑ win sɔmɔ Aseen nɔɔn di u nɛɛ,
bɛɛ Isirelibɑ i mɔ̀, sɑɑ kun turɑ i kɑ nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑni.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ bɛɛ ɡɑri yini sɔ̃ɔmɔ nɑ nɛɛ,
n bɛɛ wɛ̃re i n wɑ̃ɑ dii burɑnu sɔɔ ni bɑ sɔmɑ kuɑ, kpɑ nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru tɑ n bɑnsu sɑ̃ɑ?
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɛ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni nɑ nɛɛ, i bwisikuo bɛɛn dɑɑ ye i mɔ̀n sɔ̃.

Wee i dĩɑnu duurumɔ too, ɑdɑmɑ fiikowɑ i ɡɛ̃ɛmɔ. I dimɔ, ɑdɑmɑ i ǹ debumɔ. I nɔrumɔ, ɑdɑmɑ bɛɛn nɔru kun kpeemɔ. I yɑ̃nu dokemɔ, ɑdɑmɑ nu ǹ bɛɛ wooru ɡirɑmmɛ. Ì n bɛɛn kɔsiɑru mwɑ, tɑ rɑ doonɛwɑ nɡe te bɑ doke bɔɔ ɡɛ̃ɛre sɔɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, nɛ, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni nɑ nɛɛ, i bwisikuo bɛɛn dɑɑ ye i mɔ̀n sɔ̃.
I seewo i dɑ ɡuurɔ i dɑ̃ɑ kɑsumɑ i kɑ nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yee te bɑni, kpɑ i mɑn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃. Ye sɔɔrɑ ko nɑ n nuku dobu mɔ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.

I tɑmɑɑ i ko i dĩɑnu wɑwɑ too bɛɛn ɡbeɑn di. Adɑmɑ wee fiikowɑ i wɑ. Fiiko ye i wɑ i kɑ dɑ yɛnuɔ mi, mɑ nɑ ye wom wure nɑ yɑrinɑsiɑ. Mbɑn sɔ̃. Yèn sɔ̃ i nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yeru deri tɑ kuɑ bɑnsu. Mɑ bɑɑwure u sɛnde u kɑ win tiin diru bɑni. Nɛ, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinniwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ ɡurɑ kun mɑɑ nɛmɔ. Mɛyɑ tem kun mɑɑ bɛɛ dĩɑnu wɛ̃ɛmɔ nɡe mɛ n weenɛ.

Nɑ derɑ ɡbeburɑ kuɑ bɛɛn tem kpuro sɔɔ kɑ ɡuunɔ. Mɑ ɑlikɑmɑ kɑ resɛm kɑ olifi kpuro yɑ ɡberɑ. Dĩɑ ni tem mu rɑ kpiisie ɡesi kpuro, nu ɡberɑwɑ. Mɑ tɔmbu kɑ yɑɑ sɑbenu nɔni sɔ̃ɔre. Mɑ bɛɛn sɔmɑ ye i mɔ̀ kpuro yɑ kuɑ kɑm.

Yerɑ Sorobɑbɛli, Seɑlitiɛlin bii, kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero Yosue, Yosɑdɑkin bii, kɑ Isireli be bɑ tie kpuro, bɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinnin ɡɑri yi mɛm nɔɔwɑ nɡe mɛ Gusunɔ u win sɔmɔ Asee sɔ̃ɔwɑ u bu sɔ̃. Mɑ bɑ nɑndɑ wi, Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Asee, Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔro u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ.
Mɑ u Sorobɑbɛli, Yudɑbɑn kpɑro kɑ Yosue, yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero kɑ sere Isireli be bɑ tie dom yɑmiɑ. Bɑ nɑ bɑ ben Yinni wi u wɔllu kɑ tem mɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔmburu toruɑ,
Dɑrusin bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ yirusen suru nɔɔbɑ tiɑsen sɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nnɛse sɔɔ.
